opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 409 U. S. 1124.] Motion of Black Parents of Atlanta, Georgia, for leave to file an untimely brief as amici curiae in support of petitioners granted.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
